note: Operational preference: after initial setup, run primarily in autonomous mode. Routine posting and routine inbound replies/comments/DM responses should not require per-item approval. Escalate only genuinely ambiguous, sensitive, contractual, payment/refund, privacy/security, or explicitly human-requested interactions.
Automated inbound replies should use a human-like delay rather than instant bot timing. Routine interactions can be answered automatically; only genuinely difficult cases should be escalated.
